verdict.rationale: Missive is an email client, so alias or masked-address support is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never documents creating aliases or masked or forwarding addresses to hide a user's real address. The only 'alias' mention refers to a legacy API field name, and the distribution-list mention is a team-inbox feature; neither is relevant here.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can use aliases or masked addresses so sign-ups and strangers never learn my real address
